comments.overrides: Security-clear for the 13 pnpm-audit advisories (docs/security/security-audit.md §7). All are dev/build-time transitive tooling (eslint plugins, next-pwa/workbox build chain, next-auth's bundled uuid, next's bundled postcss, @prisma/dev) — none on the runtime request path. Each override forces the patched version WITHIN THE SAME MAJOR to avoid API breakage. Do NOT add the security-sensitive runtime deps here (next/react/next-auth/prisma/bcryptjs/zod/jose/socket.io/ioredis) — those are current and out of scope.
